description.narrative: "Supporting multi-stakeholder action to safeguard the EU Cohesion Policy” aims to contribute to the effective deployment of Integrity Pacts in procurement projects funded by the European Regional Development Fund (ERDF), Cohesion Fund, or Just Transition Fund (JTF) in interested Member States. The action targets Managing Authorities, intermediate bodies, contracting authorities, and CSOs, focusing on countries with high potential for IP implementation in the short term. Value of the contract EUR 300,000.

participating-org.narrative: European Commission - Directorate-General for Regional and Urban Policy (REGIO)
